pois.name: Fort d'Estrée
pois.wikipedia: fr:Musée historique du Sénégal à Gorée
pois.intro: The Historical Museum of Senegal in Gorée is a museum attached to the Institut fondamental d'Afrique noire and located on the island of Gorée, in the bay of Dakar, Senegal. The museum is dedicated to showing and commemorating the different stages of Senegal's history from ancient times to the country's independence.

pois.name: Ancien Musée de la Femme
pois.intro: The Henriette-Bathily Women's Museum is a museum which was located on Gorée, an island on the coast of Senegal, across from the House of Slaves museum. In May 2015, it moved to Dakar, at the Place du Souvenir Africain et de la Diaspora.

pois.name: Monument de la Renaissance Africaine
pois.intro: The African Renaissance Monument is a 50-metre tall bronze statue located on top of one of the twin hills known as Collines des Mamelles, outside Dakar, Senegal.

pois.name: Île de la Madeleine
pois.intro: The Îles de la Madeleine lie west of Dakar in Senegal. The islands are uninhabited.

pois.name: Musée Théodore-Monod d'Art africain
pois.intro: The Théodore Monod African Art Museum in Dakar, Senegal is one of the oldest art museums in West Africa. It was promoted by Léopold Senghor, the country's first President.

pois.name: Musée des Civilisations Noires
pois.intro: The Museum of Black Civilisations is a national museum in Dakar, Senegal, that opened on 6 December 2018. It is directed by Hamady Bocoum, an archaeologist and researcher at Cheikh-Anta-Diop University.

pois.name: Cathédrale du Souvenir africain
pois.wikipedia: fr:Cathédrale du Souvenir africain de Dakar
pois.intro: The Our Lady of Victories Cathedral or Cathedral of Dakar, is a religious building that serves as the Catholic cathedral in the city of Dakar, the capital of the African country of Senegal, which is the seat of the Archdiocese of Dakar. The sanctuary was built on the site of an ancient Lebu cemetery, whose land was granted by the government to the church.

pois.name: Musée de la Mer
pois.intro: The Musée de la Mer is a museum located in Gorée, Senegal. The museum contains various documents and photos on marine animals in Senegal with a collection of 6,000 species.

pois.name: Musée Léopold Sédar Senghor
pois.wikipedia: fr:Musée Senghor - Fondation Léopold Sédar Senghor
pois.intro: The Musée Senghor Fondation is a museum located in Senegal.

pois.name: Galerie Arte
pois.intro: La galerie Arte est une galerie située à Dakar, Sénégal, fondée en 1996 par Joëlle le Bussy Fal et spécialisée dans la création de meubles et d'objets d'art africain contemporain. Elle possède une succursale à Saint-Louis du Sénégal depuis 2009.

pois.name: Zoo de Hann
pois.intro: The Hann Forest and Zoological Park is a nature reserve located in Dakar, the capital of the African country of Senegal, in the Hann Bel-Air commune.

pois.name: Galerie Nationale d'Art
pois.intro: La Galleria nazionale di Dakar - Galerie nationale d'art - è uno spazio espositivo destinato all'arte contemporanea e in particolare alla produzione degli artisti senegalesi. Lo spazio è situato nel centro di Dakar in Senegal.
